footer.description: Global, transparent, and privacy-preserving lost and found recovery system connecting communities, cities, and university campuses.
footer.rights_reserved: All rights reserved. Built for community safety.

location_prompt.title: Find Items Near You
location_prompt.description: Enable location to automatically discover lost and found items in your immediate neighborhood, college campus, or public transit stop.
location_prompt.reason_1: Sorts items by distance from you in real time
location_prompt.reason_2: Locates nearby campus desks and recovery hubs
location_prompt.reason_3: Your precise GPS coordinates are never stored publicly or shared
location_prompt.secure_context_warning: Location requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).
location_prompt.error_denied: Location access was denied. You can still browse items manually by search or category.
location_prompt.error_unavailable: Location information is currently unavailable from your device.
location_prompt.error_timeout: Location request timed out. Please try again.
